ValidationRule.description: Prevents "Quarterly" and "Semi-Annual" from being selected as the Billing Frequency for products other than PerformSmart renewal.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(INCLUDES(NSP_Product_Type__c, 'Performance Management')), OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_BPS_Billing_Frequency__c, 'Quarterly'), ISPICKVAL(NSP_BPS_Billing_Frequency__c, 'Semi-Annual') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Quarterly" and "Semi-Annual" are not available for this product.
